product_one_liner.value: Ordway automates subscription and usage-based billing, payment collection, revenue recognition, and SaaS metrics reporting for businesses with recurring revenue.
product_one_liner.notes: Ordway describes its recurring-revenue audience and its subscription management, invoicing, collection, revenue recognition, and SaaS reporting functions: https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm.

pricing_page.notes: The inspected homepage has no public pricing-page link, the pricing route did not yield a page, and Ordway directs prospects to request a current proposal. Sources: https://ordwaylabs.com/ and https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm. This is an absence-based finding.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Merge's case study explicitly says it selected Ordway, and Ocrolus appears on the customer page's logo wall. Sources: https://ordwaylabs.com/resources/case-studies/technology/merge-billing-case-study and https://ordwaylabs.com/customers. | named_customers.0: Merge is explicitly identified as having selected Ordway: https://ordwaylabs.com/resources/case-studies/technology/merge-billing-case-study. | named_customers.1: Ocrolus appears on Ordway's customer logo wall: https://ordwaylabs.com/customers.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 64 employees, which falls within 51–100: https://linkedin.com/company/ordway. Profile headcounts can differ from payroll headcounts.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Ordway explicitly lists its headquarters address in Washington, DC: https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm. | hq_country: The headquarters address is Washington, DC 20016, which places it in the United States: https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm. The country is normalized from the address.

founded_year.notes: Ordway explicitly lists 2018 as its founding year: https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index shows business, finance, and product-oriented posts rather than two engineer-authored accounts of how Ordway is built. It therefore does not meet the specified engineering-blog threshold: https://ordwaylabs.com/blog. This is an index-based negative, not proof that no historical engineering article exists.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation index contains several articles, including Authentication, Filters, Sorting, Pagination, Security, and Webhooks: https://ordwaylabs.stoplight.io/docs/ordway/ZG9jOjQ4OTgxNg-overview.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Product Manager – AI Finance posting has an Apply Now link and is listed among current careers openings. Its title explicitly contains AI: https://ordwaylabs.com/careers/product-manager-ai-finance.

model_provider.notes: Ordway publicly names Anthropic Claude as an AI assistant connected through its MCP integration: https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm and https://ordwaylabs.com/products/integrations. This identifies a supported integration, not necessarily the model powering every native AI feature.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Ordway states that it is SOC 2 audited. SOC 1 is outside the requested list: https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm. | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 auditing is explicitly claimed at https://ordwaylabs.com/ai-llm.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding profile classifies the August 2026 round as Series B: https://tracxn.com. Ordway's own announcement calls it growth capital comprising equity and debt rather than explicitly naming a series: https://ordwaylabs.com/press-releases/ordway-secures-growth-capital. | funding_date: The latest financing announcement is dated August 5, 2026, yielding 2026-08: https://ordwaylabs.com/press-releases/ordway-secures-growth-capital. | funding_amount_usd: The August 5, 2026 announcement reports $20 million in growth capital. This is the combined equity-and-debt financing amount, not a separately disclosed equity-only amount: https://ordwaylabs.com/press-releases/ordway-secures-growth-capital. The funding profile also records $20 million: https://tracxn.com.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 5, 2026 financing announcement falls within the requested 18-month window: https://ordwaylabs.com/press-releases/ordway-secures-growth-capital.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Account Executive posting includes an Apply Now link and is also listed on the careers page: https://ordwaylabs.com/careers/account-executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Ordway announced AI-powered Ordway Payments on July 22, 2026, unifying billing and payments in one application. This falls within the six-month window: https://ordwaylabs.com/press-releases/ordway-launches-ai-powered-payments.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Ordway announced on April 1, 2026 that Mike Miele joined as Vice President of Sales, within the requested 12-month window: https://ordwaylabs.com/press-releases/mike-miele-vice-president-sales.
